ablation_findings.equations: Small GL benefit overall and modest July benefit, but April net worsened. Useful descriptors: sec_eff60, variance ratio, CUSUM.
ablation_findings.multi_timeframe_structure: Simple two-bar HH/HL-LH/LL vote produced effectively no decision change. One 5m completed-body feature appeared, but the encoding is too coarse.
ablation_findings.all_features: Over-combination harmed July and lowered success. More complexity without semantic ownership is rejected.

decision: DO_NOT_PROMOTE. Preserve event-time and selected tick/equation descriptors. July failure demonstrates that simple timeframe voting/pattern labels are insufficient; next rebuild hierarchical multi-scale pattern/state mechanics rather than adding more generic features.
